Name: JP's Le Pets - More Cats Variants
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][center][color=#ff00ff][u]More Cats Variants[/u][/color][/center][/size][/i][/b]



[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]You can adopt up to 40 different cats with unique fur color patterns at Marnie's ranch. [/i][/size][/color]

[size=4]These cats are more useful than the ones Marnie normally offers you, costing only 5000g (previously 40000g) and are 10% more likely to give you a gift when you pet them (30% when normally it is 20%). 
They all give the same gifts as a normal cat, with the same probabilities, but you will need less hearts to get gifts (1 heart when originally 5).

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=6][b][u][i]In order to adopt you must do one of these two options:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Reach 5 hearts with the pet Marnie finds.[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]Rejects the pet Marnie finds [/color]and[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b] wait until day 2 of year 2 to receive a letter from her. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][b]
[/b][b][i][color=#00ffff]Not much more to add, I hope you like it. [/color][/i][/b][/size]
